compared_schemes: A instrument axes plus deterministic rollup
B provision/operative episode before instrument rollup
recommendation: A storage/reporting plus demand-driven B scope episodes

rules.name: orthogonal_axes
rules.predicate: Formal disposition, operative effect, cessation cause, judicial enforceability and evidence sufficiency are distinct.
rules.scope_and_exception: Every record; never derive current force from formal label alone.

rules.name: demand_driven_episode
rules.predicate: Begin with whole instrument; split only on a material scope/date/authority conflict.
rules.scope_and_exception: Mixed clauses, conditions, savings, revivals, incorporated versions, judicial coverage.

rules.name: rollup_substantive
rules.predicate: yes if at least one supported ongoing substantive/institutional/dormant/durable/incorporated effect; no only if every substantive scope ended; otherwise indeterminate.
rules.scope_and_exception: Unknown residual may coexist with substantive=no.

rules.name: rollup_any
rules.predicate: yes if at least one supported current EO effect including genuine residual; no only if every scope ended; otherwise indeterminate.
rules.scope_and_exception: Saved independently authorized acts and historical consequences excluded by default.

rules.name: current_norm_test
rules.predicate: Identify present actor/object, command/permission/status, unexpired applicability and legal source.
rules.scope_and_exception: Counterfactual historical causation does not suffice.

rules.name: durable_status
rules.predicate: Require an identified continuing legal status and present legal consequence attributable to EO.
rules.scope_and_exception: Land/country designation needs current scope and legal bridge; no inference from social persistence.

rules.name: spent_dispositive_act_convention
rules.predicate: Primaryrollup excludes completed pure repeal/transfer/appointment effects unless an independent continuing norm/status is shown.
rules.scope_and_exception: Preserve durable_disposition tag and alternate-convention sensitivity; root must freeze this choice.

rules.name: residual_vs_saved_act
rules.predicate: Residual requires continued application of EO terms/authority; a successor saving prior acts does not alone preserve source authority.
rules.scope_and_exception: 12364 explicit terms differs from11958 saved acts;10480 preserved amendment needs separate analysis.

rules.name: incorporated_amendment
rules.predicate: Track amender-to-host-provision/version; scope cessation propagates only after entire amender footprint is mapped.
rules.scope_and_exception: No automatic formal revocation cascade; independent amender clauses survive separately.

rules.name: deadline_vs_sunset
rules.predicate: A deadline to perform is not automatic termination; distinguish office termination from all authorities termination.
rules.scope_and_exception: Store event bounds if exact cessation unknown; check targeted extensions.

rules.name: revival
rules.predicate: Revocation of a revoker alone is insufficient. Require explicit reinstatement or controlling legal rule and scope/date.
rules.scope_and_exception: Create new episode without erasing prior ended episode.

rules.name: judicial_scope
rules.predicate: Track remedy and affected clause/party/time, with later stays/modifications; do not equate injunction with repeal.
rules.scope_and_exception: Any uncertainty in remedy scope remains in judicial axis, not automatically substantive_effect.

rules.name: cleanup_dates
rules.predicate: A later cleanup revocation supplies at most latest cessation unless earlier episode end proved.
rules.scope_and_exception: first cessation, last effect end and cleanup date may differ.

rules.name: bounded_continuity
rules.predicate: Positive current predicate plus finite logged change/condition/revival/savings and identified litigation checks can bridge to cutoff.
rules.scope_and_exception: No blank-note active inference; no universal-negative proof requirement.

rules.name: source_temporality
rules.predicate: Historical1989 annotations stay historical; snippet evidence cannot decide scope-sensitive legal outcome.
rules.scope_and_exception: Preserve source_date/as_of_date/postcutoff/access flags; title/reference is not full operative text.

rules.name: batch_member_predicate
rules.predicate: Every batch member must satisfy its own predicate, scope and exception result.
rules.scope_and_exception: Collective no-longer-necessary rationale does not establish same prior mechanism/date for every target.

primary_convention: Spent pure dispositive acts: historical repeal/transfer alone is not current operative EO effect; enduring constitutive status and traceable incorporated norms may be.

headline_comparison.time_or_completion: substantive_effect=no and first cessation proved under original/existing terms by expiration, fulfilled condition or completed assignment
headline_comparison.affirmative_intervention: substantive_effect=no and first cessation attributable to later presidential, legislative, final judicial action or later-imposed sunset
headline_comparison.residual_only: substantive=no and any=yes, shown separately within ceased substantive category
headline_comparison.unallocated: indeterminate substantive OR ceased substantive with mixed/unknown first cause OR never-operative; never force into time or intervention

inference_protocol.positive: Primary operative predicate, source identity, applicable scope, incoming Stage1 change graph through cutoff, relevant sunset/authority/savings and concrete litigation leads checked. Record finite checks and gaps.
inference_protocol.negative: Primary whole cessation or mapped entire footprint; inspect savings and incoming graph for reinstatement/extension and known contrary evidence through cutoff. Early original text absent does not defeat a clear whole-revocation endpoint but makes first cessation cause unknown absent stronger evidence.
inference_protocol.modern_revocation_first_cause: For a recent operative order whose original text has continuing commands and no prior end condition, a whole primary revocation and later-change review can support presidential first cause. For old list-only targets, accept substantive/any no under bounded closure but first cause unknown unless original scope/earlier endpoint established.
inference_protocol.exceptions: Partial changes do not support whole closure. Saved independent acts do not preserve old EO authority. Residual terms with no proved surviving subjects yield indeterminate any-effect, not affirmative residual.
